extracted.intended_audience: general readers, amateur microscopists, and students interested in plant biology and popular botany
extracted.subtask_description: A popular-science magazine article that explains plant cell structure, contents (chlorophyll, starch, crystals, protoplasm), and microscopic observations for a non-specialist readership. Uses illustrative examples and simple experiments (e.g., leaf sections, yeast, hairs) to teach observational microscopy and plant physiology concepts.
